data.name: Hameedah
data.gender_notes: Hameedah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Hameed’, meaning ‘to praise’ or ‘to give thanks’. In Islamic tradition, Hameedah signifies a woman who is constantly in the state of gratitude to Allah for His blessings. The name Hameedah carries the meaning “Praised, Grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hameedah usually hope their child will grow to embody praised, grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes gratitude and appreciation towards Allah.
data.etymology: Hameedah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praised, Grateful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hameedah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Historically, this name has been given to women who displayed strong character and a thankful attitude towards Allah's blessings.

The name serves as a reminder to stay focused on Allah and to always remember the source of all blessings.
